full_judgment: In the Code of Civil Procedure there is a provision under Order 9 rule 13 to set aside an ex parte decree in a civil case. The writ court being a civil Court it does not specifically possess that power. There being no express rules in this regard, it must be held that the Writ Court must possess this power for doing justice in a case and whether the court will exercise such power is a matter of judicial discretion for that court.
